texts.gazette-2498-77: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2498/77 - 2026 ජූලි මාස 24 වාැනි සිකුරාදාා - 2026.07.24 No. 2498/77 - FRIDAY, JULY 24, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KINNIYA URBAN COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(b) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of a returned member of the Kinniya Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of resign; And whereas the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Muslim Congress, the recognized political party to which Mr. Abdul Rauf Aaris the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon a candidate of the Kinniya Urban Council who belongs to such party and who is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared Elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Mr. Varisai Mohamed Mohamed Rafi to fill the said vacancy; Therefore, I, Selladhore Kaliyuganathan Deva Neranjan, Returning Officer of the Kinniya Urban Council, acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(b) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Mr. Varisai Mohamed Mohamed Rafi was elected as the member of the Kinniya Urban Council. S. K. Deva Neranjan, Returning Officer, Kinniya Urban Council. District Elections Office, Trincomalee. 24th of July, 2026. EOG 07 – 0358 1A - PG 7834 - 04 (07/2026) PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA. This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

W. A. RAviendRA WickRAmAsinghe, Returning Officer, Negombo Municipal Council. District Elections Office, Gampaha, 27th July, 2026. texts.gazette-2499-23: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2499/23 - 2026 ජූලි මාස 28 වාැනි අඟහරුවාාදාා - 2026.07.28 No. 2499/23 - TUESDAY, JULY 28, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN OF THE AKKARAIPATTU PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66B (2) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 16 OF 2017 WHEREAS the office of Chairman in the Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of resignation; And whereas the Secretary of the National Congress, the recognized political party to which Mr. Muhammathabubacker Rasik the former Chairman belonged, was required by me under Section 66B(2) of the aforesaid Ordinance to decide upon the member of the Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall be declared elected as Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days; And Whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Mr. Abdul Manaf Ashar to fill said vacancy; Therefore I, Aththanayaka Mudiyanselage Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer of Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha acting in terms of Section 66B(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) as amended by Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 16 of 2017 do hereby declare Mr. Abdul Manaf Ashar elected as Chairman of the Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha. Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer, Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Ampara, 28th July, 2026. P. S. Pathirana, Returning Officer, Kotapola Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Matara, 28th of July, 2026. K. R. Wasundara E. Dissanayake, Returning Officer, Deraniyagala Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Kegalle, 30th of July, 2026.
